review.note: The birth or founding year, and the end where there is one, were written from memory.

summary: Mayor of Lisbon from 2007, secretary-general of the PS from 2014 and prime minister from November 2015 to March 2024, first at the head of a minority government supported from outside and, from 2022, of a majority. He resigned in November 2023 over an inquiry in which he was named and never charged.
